newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 23.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Australia's largest bank reports a strong rise in for quarter net profit before Thursday's market open. NAB also to hold annual meeting today.
Camelot makes a joint takeover for Mount Edon with Canada's Teck Corp at A$2.15 per share. Mount Edon calls the A$158 million bid "opportunistic."

Goldfields lowers net profit forecast before abnormals for year to June 30 after Wednesday's market close to between A$10 million and A$15 million due to lower gold price, higher operating costs and lower output at 25 percent owned Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea.
Transport group announced after Wednesday's market close it expected it half year profit after tax to be about 20 percent lower than that of a year earlier.
Sydney Morning Herald reports Macquarie is interested in buying the Federal Government's troubled investment bank AIDC, which is currently up for sale.
Westfield to release its 1996 year annual results
